artifact.purpose: Reference Cohort_VCF for the validation harness's strict and fuzzy concordance checks (compare_cohort_vcf, compare_cohort_vcf_fuzzy) — see Req 13.1, 13.2 and Design §Components.j.

post_gq_artifact.stage: post-FilterGenotypes (pre-AnnotateVcf) — output of the GQ_Recalibrator chain JoinRawCalls -> SVConcordance -> ScoreGenotypes -> FilterGenotypes (Definition: GQ_Recalibrator).
post_gq_artifact.purpose: Reference Cohort_VCF for the GQ_Recalibrator concordance gate added in Req 19.8. Compared against the produced post-FilterGenotypes Cohort_VCF using the same per-SV-type thresholds declared in Req 13.3 (DEL/DUP >= 99%, INS/INV >= 95%).
post_gq_artifact.relationship_to_expected_vcf: Distinct artifact. expected.vcf.gz is the post-AnnotateVcf Cohort_VCF used by the original concordance gate (Req 13.1, 13.2). expected_post_gq_vcf is the upstream sibling at the post-FilterGenotypes stage; both live alongside in s3://omics-ref-ap-southeast-1-__ACCOUNT_ID__/gatk-sv/validation/broad-reference/ and cover different stages of the pipeline.
status_notes: Not yet produced. The validation harness skips the post-GQ concordance gate while expected_post_gq_vcf_sha256 is null in the consuming manifest.

Will be produced on the first end-to-end run that exercises the GQ_Recalibrator chain (Phase 8 of tasks.md), then uploaded to s3://omics-ref-ap-southeast-1-__ACCOUNT_ID__/gatk-sv/validation/broad-reference/ alongside the existing expected.vcf.gz.
regeneration_triggers: Any caller container in `callers.container_versions` is upgraded.
Any reference file in reference-bundle/manifests/GRCh38.json is upgraded.
The upstream commit pinned in `upstream_pipeline.broad_reference_vcf_commit` is bumped.
A divergence is added to or removed from any module bundle on the GQ_Recalibrator path (JoinRawCalls, SVConcordance, ScoreGenotypes, FilterGenotypes) — see docs/divergence-log.md.

status_notes: The binary expected.vcf.gz and .tbi are intentionally gitignored by validation-cohort/.gitignore.

They are produced once on Terra/Cromwell-on-GCP per docs/validation-runbook.md Step 1, uploaded to s3://omics-ref-ap-southeast-1-__ACCOUNT_ID__/gatk-sv/validation/broad-reference/, and downloaded to this directory before running the acceptance test.
The acceptance test tests/gatk_sv_healthomics/acceptance/test_validation_concordance.py becomes runnable once expected.vcf.gz is present locally.
When a real expected.vcf.gz is downloaded, regenerate this file's `artifact_checksums` block (see `regeneration_procedure` below) so the Migration_System can detect tampering.

broad_reference_vcf_commit_notes: This is the commit Broad's upstream WDL was run at on Terra/Cromwell-on-GCP to produce expected.vcf.gz.
It matches the GATK image tag baked into the HealthOmics container registry map (gatk:mw-gatk-sv-672d85), so HealthOmics output and Broad output use the same GATK build.
healthomics_phase8_amendment_commit_note: v1.1 release tag commit; pinned in scripts/bootstrap/08_register_workflows.py.

Adds EvidenceQC, RefineComplexVariants, JoinRawCalls, SVConcordance, ScoreGenotypes, FilterGenotypes, MainVcfQC, VisualizeCnvs (Phase 8 of tasks.md, currently in-flight at the time of this metadata snapshot).
Phase 8 modules are *not* in the path that produced the v1.0 expected.vcf.gz; they will require a fresh expected when first activated end-to-end.

callers.melt_exclusion_rationale: Req 23.3 — MELT is GPL-licensed and incompatible with the redistribution model. Mobile-element-insertion sensitivity is reduced; tradeoff accepted per Req 23.5.

healthomics_workflow_versions.version_naming_scheme: Semver tags applied at registration time by gatk_sv_healthomics.registrar.register_module; current versions are tracked in workflow-versions.json and emitted with the cost-tag `gatk-sv:workflow-version=V` (see Property 10).
notes: These workflow IDs are the targets of the validation cohort run that produces the *next* expected.vcf.gz. They are NOT necessarily the workflow IDs that produced the current expected.vcf.gz, since expected.vcf.gz is generated on Terra/Cromwell-on-GCP, not on HealthOmics (see Req 13.1 and docs/validation-runbook.md Step 1).
When the expected.vcf.gz is regenerated from a HealthOmics run instead of Terra, populate `produced_by_run` below with the HealthOmics run IDs that produced it.

produced_by_run.engine_notes: Per Req 13.1 the expected.vcf.gz is produced by Broad's upstream WDL on Terra so the HealthOmics output can be compared to a known-good ground truth. See docs/validation-runbook.md Step 1.

trigger_conditions: Any caller container in `callers.container_versions` is upgraded.
Any reference file in reference-bundle/manifests/GRCh38.json is upgraded.
The upstream commit pinned in `upstream_pipeline.broad_reference_vcf_commit` is bumped.
A divergence is added to or removed from any module bundle (see docs/divergence-log.md).
procedure: 1. Re-run Broad's upstream WDL on Terra at the new upstream commit on the same 10-sample cohort. See docs/validation-runbook.md Step 1.
3. `aws s3 cp` both files into validation-cohort/expected/.
4. Compute SHA-256 and byte size for each:
5. Update the `artifact_checksums` block of this file with the new digests, sizes, ISO-8601 `computed_at`, and `computed_by` operator name.
7. Re-run `tests/gatk_sv_healthomics/acceptance/test_validation_concordance.py` and confirm DEL/DUP >= 99% and INS/INV >= 95% concordance against the new expected.
8. Commit this file (the binary VCF is gitignored — do NOT commit it).
regeneration_procedure.freshness_requirement: Req 13.2 — the validation harness compares produced against expected; this metadata records what `expected` represents, so it MUST be updated whenever any input above changes.
